content.title: 3M 461-1276 Grey Reusable Safety Gloves - PPE Hand Protection
content.short_description: 3M 461-1276 reusable safety gloves in grey. Classified as Personal Protective Equipment for hand protection applications.
content.long_description:
The 3M 461-1276 is a reusable safety glove designed for personal protective equipment applications requiring hand protection. Finished in grey, this glove is intended for repeated use rather than single-wear disposal, supporting facilities looking to manage PPE inventory and reduce per-use consumable costs.

As part of 3M's Protective Equipment line, the 461-1276 falls under the Safety & Facility category for personal protective equipment procurement. It is classified specifically as a Safety Glove type of PPE.

Confirm fit, size, and application-specific chemical or mechanical resistance requirements against your facility's safety data sheets and job hazard analysis before deployment, as specific performance ratings are not listed here.
